newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up 25 cents at 14.08 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up 25 cents at 14.08 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed 25 cents up at 14.08 ringgit ($5.61) a kg on Friday after an overnight surge on the London Metal Exchange, traders said.

"There was strong buying from Europe due to the LME's rise," said a dealer. "The market has been quite undervalued if compared to the LME's recent gains and the previous price of below 14 ringgit was seen as attractive," he said.
Bids, also from locals, overwhelmed offers by 195 to 85 tonnes. Final turnover was 115 tonnes, against 93 on Thursday.
The local price premium against London widened to $85 from $50. -- K. Baranee Krishnaan (603-275-6833) ($1=2.5120 rgt)
